panel.why: B's headline puts the $18M partner-sourced pipeline and the Head of Partnerships, martech and data, framing where I scan, though the visible bracketed placeholders make it look unfinished and A is the cleaner file.

A reads as a finished, credible record of the same achievements, while B has about fifteen unfilled bracket fields, such as the company description, baselines and ARR, that suggest a draft and leave the scope of the work unclear.

A is a sendable document with real numbers, while B's placeholders, and a Head of Partnerships headline over a Director title, make it look unready and slightly inflated, even though its summary states the outcome better.
